sub_graphs.title: EIP-1: EIP Status State Machine
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle states of an EIP and valid transitions between them

nodes.label: EIP Idea Stage
nodes.description: Pre-draft stage where proposal exists only as discussion, not formally tracked

nodes.label: EIP Draft Status
nodes.description: First formally tracked stage after EIP Editor merges properly formatted submission

nodes.label: EIP Review Status
nodes.description: Author has marked EIP ready for peer review by the community

nodes.label: EIP Last Call Status
nodes.description: Final review window (typically 14 days) before finalization with deadline set

nodes.label: EIP Final Status
nodes.description: Completed standard; only errata and clarifications allowed

nodes.label: EIP Stagnant Status
nodes.description: EIP inactive for 6+ months in Draft, Review, or Last Call status

nodes.label: EIP Withdrawn Status
nodes.description: Author-initiated permanent rejection; cannot be resurrected

nodes.label: EIP Living Status
nodes.description: Continuous update status for proposals designed for ongoing evolution

nodes.label: Submit EIP Draft
nodes.description: Author submits formally formatted EIP to repository via PR

nodes.label: Mark Ready for Review
nodes.description: Author marks EIP as ready for peer review

nodes.label: Open Last Call PR
nodes.description: Author opens PR with last-call-deadline to begin final review period

nodes.label: Finalize EIP
nodes.description: Submit PR containing only status update to Final

nodes.label: Withdraw EIP
nodes.description: Author permanently rejects the EIP with withdrawal-reason field

nodes.label: Auto-Stagnate EIP
nodes.description: System automatically marks EIP stagnant after 6 months inactivity

nodes.label: Resurrect EIP
nodes.description: Author or editor resurrects stagnant EIP back to earlier status

edges.label: EIP enters last call with deadline

external_entities.name: EIP Author
external_entities.description: External party proposing and championing an EIP through the process

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1: EIP Content Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules and checks applied to EIP submissions

nodes.label: EIP PR Submitted
nodes.description: EIP pull request has been submitted to the repository

nodes.label: Validate RFC 822 Preamble
nodes.description: Check preamble has RFC 822 headers in specified order

nodes.label: Validate Title Constraints
nodes.description: Check title is max 44 chars, excludes 'standard' and EIP number

nodes.label: Validate Description Constraints
nodes.description: Check description is max 140 chars, excludes 'standard' and EIP number

nodes.label: Validate Required Sections
nodes.description: Check presence of Abstract, Specification, Rationale, Security Considerations

nodes.label: Validate Date Formats
nodes.description: Check created/deadline dates are ISO 8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd)

nodes.label: Validate External Links
nodes.description: Check external links anchor to specific commits/versions per allowed list

nodes.label: Validate EIP Category
nodes.description: For Standards Track EIPs, check category is Core, Networking, Interface, or ERC

nodes.label: Validate Opcode References
nodes.description: For Core EIPs, check opcodes referenced by mnemonic and hex value

nodes.label: Validate Test Cases Present
nodes.description: For consensus-affecting proposals, check test cases are mandatory

nodes.label: Validate Copyright Waiver
nodes.description: Check copyright waiver via CC0 is present

nodes.label: EIP Validation Passed
nodes.description: All validation checks have passed

nodes.label: EIP Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed, PR needs revision

nodes.label: Assign EIP Number
nodes.description: Editor assigns incremental EIP number to valid submission

external_entities.name: EIP Editor
external_entities.description: Repository maintainer who validates and merges EIP submissions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1: Security Considerations Review
sub_graphs.description: Models the security review requirements and trust boundaries in the EIP process

nodes.label: Security Considerations Missing
nodes.description: EIP does not have a Security Considerations section

nodes.label: Security Considerations Present
nodes.description: EIP has a Security Considerations section

nodes.label: Review Security Adequacy
nodes.description: Editor reviews whether security considerations are adequate

nodes.label: Security Treatment Inadequate
nodes.description: Security considerations section does not adequately address risks

nodes.label: Security Treatment Adequate
nodes.description: Security considerations section adequately addresses risks

nodes.label: Blocked from Final Status
nodes.description: EIP cannot progress to Final without adequate security treatment

nodes.label: Eligible for Final Status
nodes.description: EIP security requirements met, can progress to Final

nodes.label: Discuss on AllCoreDevs
nodes.description: Core EIP presented and discussed on AllCoreDevs call

nodes.label: Assess Cross-Client Implementation
nodes.description: Core developers gauge cross-client implementation plans

nodes.label: Rough Consensus Reached
nodes.description: Proposal deemed non-contentious and technically sound

external_entities.name: Ethereum Core Developers
external_entities.description: Client implementation teams who review and implement Core EIPs

ambiguities.text: Security Considerations section that discusses the security implications/considerations relevant to the proposed change. There is no description of what counts as 'adequate treatment'.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume adequacy is determined by EIP editor discretion and AllCoreDevs discussion for Core EIPs. Criteria should include threat modeling, attack vectors, and mitigations.

ambiguities.text: Build 'rough consensus' around idea (assumes proposals are non-contentious and technically sound by default).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume rough consensus means no sustained objections from core developers after AllCoreDevs discussion, not unanimous agreement.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define what triggers resurrection of a stagnant EIP or who has authority to resurrect.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume both original author and EIP editors can initiate resurrection, likely via PR submission.

implicit_assumptions.description: EIP Editors are trusted to make impartial decisions about EIP validity without passing judgment on proposal merit.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Biased editors could gatekeep proposals, preventing legitimate improvements from entering the process.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Ethereum Magicians forum and AllCoreDevs calls remain functional venues for EIP discussion and consensus building.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without these venues, there is no defined alternative for community consensus, potentially stalling all EIP progress.

implicit_assumptions.description: External links anchored to specific commits cannot be modified after the commit is published.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If commits can be rewritten (e.g., force push), linked content could change after EIP finalization, introducing specification drift.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot impersonate EIP editors or gain write access to the EIP repository.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious EIPs could be merged or legitimate EIPs modified, potentially introducing protocol vulnerabilities.
